title: run and publish ids the log's scrubber leaves whole

findings.claim: the adapter drew a run's and a publish's id as 8 random bytes in hex; about 1 draw in 130 holds a digit run the log's scrubber reads as a phone number (CI's draw in job 139204992870 was logged as d6d8b[PHONE]a), so no log line held the id the run record sends its reader to (CI-1, the 1-in-140 flake of test_adapter_failure_words.py)
findings.severity_basis: not a leak: the reader cannot find a failed run's log lines by its id, and every counted full-set run can meet the flake
findings.fix: tb_common.ids.log_safe_id: 16 lower-case letters (75 bits, against 64), a draw the scrubber would still change drawn again; the three draw sites of services/adapter/app.py use it; tests/unit/test_h147_ids_unmasked.py (2 of its tests fail at master 440089e8)
findings.from: the integrator's 7164002927 and the external review's 7163988253 on #1513, 2026-11-25

findings.claim: the criteria compiler's error_id (uuid4().hex[:12]) is logged with the error and given to the caller to find it by; the scrubber changes 1251 of 200000 such draws (about 1 in 160), the same defect as H147-01
findings.severity_basis: a 500's error id is not found in the log about 1 time in 160
findings.fix: the integrator's ruling 7166734383: services/criteria_compiler/app.py draws error_id with tb_common.ids.log_safe_id(); the length assertion of tests/unit/test_compiler_answers_every_failure.py::test_a_bug_is_a_500_with_an_id_and_its_trace_in_the_audit changes from 12 to 16 under that ruling; tests/unit/test_h147_ids_unmasked.py::test_the_compilers_error_id_is_logged_whole (fails at fab3329f)
findings.from: lane H, while finding every draw site for H-147, 2026-11-25

findings.claim: the console's cascade run id (a ULID, digits and capitals) is logged when a cascade run fails; the scrubber changes 59 of 200000 ULIDs (about 1 in 3400)
findings.severity_basis: rare; the run is found by its trial and time as well
findings.fix: the integrator's ruling 7166734383: services/console/cascade.py draws the run id with tb_common.ids.log_safe_id() (one line and its import); tests/unit/test_h147_ids_unmasked.py::test_a_cascade_runs_id_is_logged_whole (fails at fab3329f)
findings.from: lane H, while finding every draw site for H-147, 2026-11-25

findings.claim: log_safe_id() redrew with no bound: a site chart-number pattern that reads letters (^[A-Za-z0-9]{6,20}$, which the settings take) changed every draw, so POST /run and POST /publish spun for ever while they held the adapter's run gate (review 1515-1; not on master)
findings.severity_basis: on such a site no night runs and no publish ends; the shipped default reads digits only
findings.fix: at most ATTEMPTS (32) draws, then the last draw is handed out (a valid id whose log line shows the rule's kind); tests/unit/test_h147_ids_unmasked.py::test_a_site_rule_that_reads_letters_does_not_hang_the_draw, ::test_a_run_is_started_under_a_site_rule_that_reads_letters (both fail at b7fc5914)
findings.from: the external review of #1515 at b7fc5914 (7166485201), 2026-11-25
